person_note: The main Zachary/Dorian narrative and the embedded fables are sustained third-person narration, corroborated by the publisher samples and explicit POV sources. Book 6, however, repeatedly alternates those third-person chapters with constitutive excerpts from Katrina Hawkins's diary narrated as I; several input quotes come from that diary. Under the methodology, a sustained first-person diary section alternating with sustained third-person sections requires ALTERNATING, even though many general descriptions call the novel third person. Apparent first person in q03924 and q03933 and second person in q03940 are character speech, not additional base strands. Confidence is medium because the third-person route has Tier A support, while the whole-book first/third configuration is established by weaker structural sources plus quote attribution rather than an authorized interior excerpt.
